vocabulary_audit.retrospective_guard: generic night/morning/day/evening attack-consequence summaries without episode-specific temporal proof are prevented from same-day sensitivity inference

control_replay.interpretation: No currently retained queue candidate changes classification outcome under the expanded taxonomy. New damage/fire capability is therefore exercised by regression fixtures but introduces no accidental current-queue reclassification.
